notes: BegVault is immutable, with no owner, admin, pause or upgrade functions. Constructor arguments are BEG token, team payment beneficiary, Intake, IMD, oracle signer and entry price (0.005 ETH). $owner receives the team payment entitlement without administrative powers. Protocol addresses follow the accepted deployment documentation; live verification remains a predeployment requirement. BegVault starts unfunded and rejects attempts with VaultEmpty until funded by a BEG transfer after deployment. The intended launch-wallet funding amount is not enforced on chain. No initialization calls are required. The factory supplies MerkleDistributor and the initialization-only pool guard. The service derives the opening price from launch policy.
